generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense
generalAbilities.description: A thresher lord can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Colony Mind
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deflecting Blades
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature adjacent to the thresher lord targets the thresher lord with a melee attack

Effect The thresher lord gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blade Storm
offensiveAbilities.description: The thresher lord makes three arm blade Strikes. Each Strike uses the thresher lord's current multiple attack penalty, but each Strike takes a –2 penalty. This counts as three attacks when calculating its multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hurtle
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The thresher lord Strides up to three times its Speed in a straight line.

offensiveAbilities.name: Serrated Blades
offensiveAbilities.description: On a critical hit with an arm blade Strike, the thresher lord inflicts 1d8 Persistent,bleed Damage damage to its target.
